run_consolidate_fsdp_shards: run the consolidate_fsdp_shards script to merge FSDP checkpoint shards into a single consolidated checkpoint file
run_consolidate_with_save_prefix: run consolidate_fsdp_shards with a custom save_prefix to specify the output path for the consolidated checkpoint
run_consolidate_strict_mode: run consolidate_fsdp_shards with strict mode enabled to enforce strict validation of shard metadata during consolidation
run_consolidate_ema_checkpoint: run consolidate_fsdp_shards with is_ema flag to consolidate exponential moving average checkpoint shards
run_consolidate_megatron_part: run consolidate_fsdp_shards with megatron_part to consolidate a specific model parallel shard from a Megatron checkpoint
